page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth remains average for both small cached blocks and larger uncached blocks, though Passmark memory scores are weak. Cryptographic and vector instructions are supported via AES, AVX, and AVX512F flags.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.3xlarge offers dedicated CPU resources on an older hardware generation, making it a stable option for workloads that require predictable CPU allocation without the premium cost of newer architectures. Given its balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio and average multi-threaded performance, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded text and image processing, software compilation, Redis database operations, and moderate web serving.
